summary.headline: Preface: Acknowledgments
summary.text: The preface acknowledges the edition’s imperfections and hopes that future scholars will improve it, then thanks Hermann Usener, Richard Wuensch, Joseph Bidez, Aeneas Piccolomini, Christian Huelsen, Cerocchi, and Wilhelm Kroll for excerpts, manuscript work, astrological-volume research, and proofreading. Dated Brussels, 15 August 1898.
